title: Time-to-event and survival analysis
purpose: Estimates Kaplan-Meier survival curves and compares event timing between AI and comparator groups using a log-rank test.
input: `Data` sheet with patient_id, duration, event, group, and optional subgroup.
outputs: Kaplan-Meier estimates, median survival, survival curves, log-rank statistic and p-value, subgroup tables, and event-risk interpretation.
limitations: This is an educational example. It is not a clinical device, validated decision instrument, or substitute for local statistical, economic, legal, privacy, cybersecurity, ethics, quality, or health-technology-assessment review.
